async def protocol(lh: LiquidHandler):
    """
    Main protocol function for PyLabRobot.

    This function contains all the liquid handling operations.
    The AI Agent will replace the placeholder below with generated protocol logic.

    Args:
        lh (LiquidHandler): The liquid handler instance for performing operations
    """
    
    # [AGENT_CODE_STUB]
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Resource lookup - all four resources are pre-configured on the deck
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    dest = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Protocol parameters
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    transfer_volume = 40.0  # uL - kept below the 50 uL tip capacity
    source_wells = ["A1", "B1", "C1", "D1"]   # column 1 of the source plate
    dest_wells = ["A1", "B1", "C1", "D1"]     # column 1 of the destination plate
    tip_wells = ["A1", "B1", "C1", "D1"]      # one fresh tip per transfer

    if not (len(source_wells) == len(dest_wells) == len(tip_wells)):
        raise ValueError("source_wells, dest_wells and tip_wells must have equal length")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Main transfer loop: source -> destination, fresh tip for every well
    # (clean tip per well avoids any carry-over between samples)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    transfers_completed = 0
    total_volume = 0.0

    for src_well, dst_well, tip_well in zip(source_wells, dest_wells, tip_wells):
        # 1. acquire a tip
        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack[tip_well])

        # 2. pull liquid from the source well
        await lh.aspirate(source[src_well], vols=[transfer_volume])

        # 3. deliver it into the matching destination well
        await lh.dispense(dest[dst_well], vols=[transfer_volume])

        # 4. return the tip so the deck stays tidy for inspection
        await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack[tip_well])

        transfers_completed += 1
        total_volume += transfer_volume
        print(f"[transfer] {src_well} -> {dst_well}: {transfer_volume:g} uL")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # End-of-run summary (also useful as the simulation result printout)
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    print("--- SIMULATION SUMMARY ---")
    print(f"robot model        : generic / hamilton_star (simple_deck)")
    print(f"transfers executed : {transfers_completed}")
    print(f"total volume moved : {total_volume:g} uL")
    print(f"tips consumed      : {transfers_completed} of 96 available")
    print(f"source wells read  : {', '.join(source_wells)}")
    print(f"dest wells written : {', '.join(dest_wells)}")
    print("final deck state   : all tips returned, plates and trough untouched")

    print("--- PROTOCOL_SUCCESS ---")
